title: Pictures
summary: Everyday objects learnt from a drawing of each instead of a translation.
description: For concrete things, the word attaches to the thing faster from a picture than from English.

requirements.text: The tutor makes a picture lesson from at least four concrete objects, with its own tool; it is always of low complexity.
A picture lesson can be started at once; its pictures are drawn in the background.
A word whose picture is not drawn yet is left out of practice until it is.
Asked to pick a picture, the learner chooses among four, each of a different word; with fewer than four pictures to choose from, the picture is shown and the word picked instead.
A picture lesson ends with a memory round matching pictures with their words, when at least four pictured words differ.
